**Bispebjerg: Psykiatrisk ambulatorium, børn og unge** (Bispebjerg: Psychiatric Outpatient Clinic, Children and Adolescents) is a specialized psychiatric department operating within the Capital Region of Denmark (Region Hovedstaden). The clinic is integrated into the national clinical quality framework and submits its diagnostic and treatment data to the [[adhd-databasen|ADHD-DATABASEN]] [^src2].

In the 2023/24 reporting period, the clinic demonstrated notable performance in early childhood ADHD diagnostics. It achieved a 63% fulfillment rate for quality indicator 2a, which measures the proportion of ADHD diagnostic processes for children aged 0–5 where the child is assessed via clinical environmental observation within 120 days of the assessment's start [^src1]. This 63% fulfillment rate (34 out of 54 cases) places the clinic significantly above the Capital Region's average of 52%, indicating better diagnostic practices and resource utilization than many other departments in the region [^src1]. However, it still falls short of the strict national standard of ≥90% for this indicator, reflecting broader systemic challenges across Danish child psychiatry regarding capacity, resource distribution, and clinical variation.

Regarding pharmacological treatment, the clinic's performance is tracked under [[indikator-6|Indikator 6]]. Data from the 2024 reporting period shows that the clinic maintains a medication rate of 61% [^src2]. This metric contributes to the national evaluation of the balance between non-pharmacological and pharmacological treatment components in the Danish ADHD intervention system, highlighting the clinic's role in the broader landscape of psychiatric care for youth.
